mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of months when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 2.0% signals monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months when FEDFUNDS rises above 2.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) and strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 150,000) signals a tight labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of months when both UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS > 150,000, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening, which suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST > 1600.0) signal robust residential demand, which supports economic growth and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of months when HOUST > 1600.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105.0 signals a supply contraction, which increases input costs and reduces corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months when INDPRO < 105.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production (INDPRO > 110.0) signals strong supply capacity, which supports economic output and corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of months when INDPRO > 110.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 150,000) signals a healthy labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of months when PAYEMS > 150,000, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.
